meta.name: Rachael Ray Presents
meta.description:
Rachael Ray, beloved for her warmth, humor, and real-world recipes, welcomes you into her kitchen alongside Buddy Valastro, and Sohla El-Waylly. From easy meals to culinary adventures, this is comfort food and TV served all day, every day.

Shows: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes, Rachael Ray in Tuscany, Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty, Legends of the Fork, The Fast History Of
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
